definitions.gloss: happiness; gladness; how glad one feels
definitions.explanation: The noun form of {嬉|うれ}しい. It names the gladness felt at a particular good thing, and often its intensity, rather than happiness as a state of life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧{嬉|うれ}しさ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泣|な}いた→泣く：00655_naku⟧。
examples.english: I cried from the joy of passing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}えた→会う：00482_au⟧{嬉|うれ}しさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I can't forget how glad I was to meet them after so long.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ほめられた{嬉|うれ}しさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{表|あらわ}せない→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: The gladness of having my own work praised for the first time cannot be put into words.

notes:
Formed by replacing the final い of ⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧ with さ, the regular way to make a noun of degree from an i-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嬉|うれ}しさ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧: out of sheer joy
- {嬉|うれ}しさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧こみ{上|あ}げる: gladness wells up
- {嬉|うれ}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}せない→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧: to be unable to hide one's delight
- {嬉|うれ}しさ⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧: half glad (and half something else)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧: joy — larger and more lasting, and usable of an occasion as well as a feeling
- {楽|たの}しさ: fun, enjoyment — pleasure taken in an activity while it lasts
